==Usage==
This template should be placed at the top of the actual [[Wookieepedia:Featured article reviews|Featured article review]] page to be archived. To use this template, copy and paste one of the following:
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:FAR archive|passed}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{subst:FAR archive}}</nowiki></code> for successful reviews, or
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:FAR archive|failed}}</nowiki></code> for unsuccessful reviews.

Finally, add a <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code> tag at the very end of the page.
